body:
## Summary
- Require retained file-transfer product E2E evidence to declare schema_version=vibescreen.evidence/v1 before the bidirectional product subcheck can pass.
- Apply the same product schema precheck to cancel cleanup so stale or missing schemas do not produce inconsistent sub-gate status.
- Document the schema requirement and refresh README no-Host UI/UX evidence links to the 2026-09-08 current-main rerun record.

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke -v: 37 tests OK.
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v: 146 tests OK.
- make evidence-tools-test: 1440 tests OK.
- make file-transfer-android-smoke EVIDENCE_DIR=.build/evidence/file-transfer-schema-version-gate: generated the expected blocked report because real Host/product evidence is absent.
- git diff --check: passed.

## Boundaries
- This is evidence-tool and documentation hardening only.
- It did not launch Vibe Screen or the Host GUI, run swift run, touch TCC/Keychain/System Settings, or create adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321.
- It does not close Android/macOS file-transfer product E2E. That gate still requires retained Host-backed bidirectional product evidence with sender action, receiver approval, protocol packets, remote-file bytes, SHA-256 equality, positive session epoch, distinct transfer IDs, observed progress, and cancel cleanup.
title: test(evidence): require file-transfer product schema
